purpose: Test a new exploratory current-value observation with counterbalanced value identities: do redundant and novel final writes yield different current-value accuracy despite the same final executable state? Preserve the failed historical-preservation primary from the previous protocol; this study is not a replacement success criterion.

reference.previous_registered_history_primary: failed: discovery1qualified stream, replica0; baseline history16/16 in both128-account cohorts

exploratory_current_A_observation.scope: Numeric-output matches are descriptive, not an attribution to storage damage. Repeated and novel values were not counterbalanced in the source study.

construction.entity_rng: Shuffle E700..E899 with random.Random(base_seed); first three identities are A,B,C. All cells and value siblings use identical identities.
construction.value_rng: random.Random(base_seed+410009).sample(range(100,1000),4*162); contiguous162-value slice per value sibling. Initial I=values[0], X=values[3], Y=values[160], new_C=values[161]; all are distinct.
construction.record_0: SET A I, the only standalone SET value occurrence of I in every world.
construction.records_1_2: SET B values[1]; SET C values[2].
construction.record_3: SET A X for cells starting X; SET A Y for cells starting Y.
construction.records_4_159: 156 SET distractor records, never A/B/C, using independently shuffled cycles of entities[3:128] from random.Random(base_seed+310003+128); record i uses values[i]. Every active account appears.
construction.record_160: SET A X for cells ending X; SET A Y for cells ending Y.
construction.record_161: SET C new_C in all four worlds.
construction.queries: Unchanged native ledger instructions and exact initial-A/current-A/current-C questions. Condition labels X/Y/repeat/novel never appear in prompts.
construction.truth: For a fixed final value, both execute(initial) and execute(current) maps must be identical across repeat and novel worlds for ALL accounts, not merely the queried ones. Current A is the final X/Y, initial A is I, current C is new_C. Different intermediate histories are allowed; no equality of complete hidden states is required.
construction.controlled_difference: Within each same-final-value pair, the final A/C records, query and answer are byte/token-identical; the only changed tokens are the three isolated value digits at the earlier record3. Across final X/Y at fixed early value, only record160 digits change; current-A truth must change accordingly.
construction.interpretation: Counterbalancing prevents assigning all errors to a particular repeated answer code or comparing different gold numbers. Remaining effects may involve query formation, Attention, recurrent/convolution paths or ordinary pattern generalization; they do not establish irreversible memory damage or joint-interface necessity.

data_audits: Recompute all four worlds with the executable SET interpreter. Verify complete initial/current state-map equality within each same-final-value contrast and required current-A sensitivity across final X/Y.
Exactly160common-format prefix records and2tail records,128distinct active accounts, a single numeric I occurrence, no A/B/C distractor writes, both X/Y distinct from I.
Four value siblings have identical questions, entity/operation schedules and token boundaries and four distinct own-world answers for each role/cell.

All384questions have audited source, record and digit boundaries, fixed answer tokenization and no truncation. Same-final paired prompts differ only at record3 value digits; fixed-early final toggles differ only at record160 digits.
Freeze the full ordered registry and sources before inference; retain all cases, baseline failures, value siblings and guard failures. No error-only filtering or checkpoint selection.
New97600/97700 seed ranges were absent from configs/scripts/tests before registration; preserve the reserved70000-series cohort and every prior source artifact.

evaluation.execution: Existing local Qwen3.5-2B IT, same base environment, eager BF16, fresh full prefill for every physical query. No training, adapters, oracle address or mixed cache.
evaluation.generation: Unrestricted greedy, maximum12new tokens, newline/EOS stop; three-digit gold NLL separately. Same-final contrast compares identical gold token sequences.
evaluation.smoke: First lexicographic case/value in each cohort:2cases,8worlds,24queries. Operational coverage and runtime safety only, no performance gate.
evaluation.safety: Independent smoke audit before complete384queries. Pin actual model/tokenizer/config/runtime and source hashes; unchanged complete loaded-state hashes/no gradients; actual six-layer historical access and exact native readout replays on min/max case identities per cohort for all four cells, sampling current-A questions:16full checks/replays,8smoke.
evaluation.primary_unit: For each same-final pair, reference is novel and candidate is repeated. Raw repeat loss = reference-current-A-correct/candidate-wrong; rescue is the reverse. A qualified loss/rescue additionally requires initial A and current C correct in BOTH worlds.
evaluation.stream_analysis: Each base stream has4value siblings times2final identities =8paired current-value outcomes. Compute raw and qualified signed net losses(lost minus rescued) per stream and per cohort; keep all numerators/denominators and every case.
evaluation.primary_gate: In EACH cohort, novel-current-A baseline is at least24/32, raw net repeat loss is positive, qualified net repeat loss is positive, and qualified net repeat loss is positive in at least2distinct base streams. This is a descriptive replicated direction check, not statistical significance. Do not substitute one final-value identity or a filtered subgroup for this gate.
evaluation.reporting: All four cells, both final-value contrasts, all roles/joint outcomes, per-value/per-stream/paired outputs, all raw and qualified losses/rescues and NLL shifts. Report complete four-cell current-A sensitivity and preservation guards. Related value/cell/query outcomes are not independent trials.
evaluation.if_absent: Retain the failed historical primary and record that the new repeat-versus-novel observation did not survive the registered counterbalance. No threshold adjustment, additional load hunting or automatic architecture training.
evaluation.if_present: Register a separate mechanism diagnosis or frozen-checkpoint sufficiency comparison before any architecture training. The target remains semantic overwrite-history dependence in the existing hybrid block; shared control must still beat independent and ordinary question-stage controls under matched budgets.

scope: New hypothesis from a secondary observation, registered on entirely new streams. It supplements the earlier independence/order/COPY/history controls and does not turn their negative results into positive findings.
implementation_status: Protocol only; data provider, frozen dataset, runner, auditor and model inference not started.
